# Statuses of the @VAR@ substitutions in libgcc/Makefile.in, through which
# libgcc's configure passes its results to the build.
# //runtimes/libgcc/tests:configure_inventory_* fails for a substitution
# without a status.
#
# Columns: variable, status, and for modeled ones the port file that carries
# its value, which must mention the variable. A gcc=<first>-<last> field limits
# the line to the GCC versions from <first> up to but not including <last>.
# Either bound may be left out, and a field may list several ranges,
# comma-separated.
#
# modeled: the port carries its value in that file.
# toolchain: the cc toolchain provides it, as a tool or as compile flags. PICFLAG
#   is one, since the port's objects are already position-independent.
# not-needed: an install path or build tool, which Bazel replaces; a warning
#   flag, which does not change the objects; or a setting that only the parts
#   this port leaves out read, such as startfiles, crtstuff and multilibs.
# unsupported-feature: an optional part of libgcc this port does not build.
# unsupported-target: set or read only for targets this port does not support.
AR toolchain
AWK not-needed
CC toolchain
CET_FLAGS modeled 3rd_party/gcc/libgcc/target_config.bzl
CFLAGS toolchain
HAVE_STRUB_SUPPORT modeled 3rd_party/gcc/libgcc/makefile.bzl gcc=14.0.0-
INSTALL not-needed
INSTALL_DATA not-needed
INSTALL_PROGRAM not-needed
LIPO toolchain
LN_S not-needed
MAINT not-needed
NM toolchain
NO_PIE_CFLAGS not-needed gcc=16.0.0-
PICFLAG toolchain
RANLIB toolchain
